```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
params_A <- c(
  Lambda = 50,   # Recruitment rate
  beta   = 0.0018, # Scenario A: R0 < 1
  sigma  = 0.4,  # Exposure to malpractice rate
  tau    = 0.3,  # Orientation (E -> H) rate
  alpha  = 0.2,  # Detection/cancellation rate
  delta  = 0.1,  # Direct recovery (M -> R) rate
  gamma  = 0.5,  # Recovery after cancellation (C -> R) rate
  eps    = 0.2,  # Transition (R -> H) rate
  omega  = 0.05, # Reversion (H -> S) rate
  mu     = 0.1   # Natural exit rate
)

params_B <- params_A
params_B["beta"] <- 0.003  # Scenario B: R0 > 1
init <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)
times <- seq(0, 6, by = 0.01)
malpractice_ode <- function(t, state, params) {
  with(as.list(c(state, params)), {
    dS <- Lambda + omega * H - beta * S * M - mu * S
    dE <- beta * S * M - (tau + sigma + mu) * E
    dM <- sigma * E - (mu + alpha + delta) * M
    dC <- alpha * M - (mu + gamma) * C
    dR <- gamma * C + delta * M - (eps + mu) * R
    dH <- tau * E + eps * R - (omega + mu) * H
    list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH))
  })
}
out_A <- as.data.frame(ode(init, times, malpractice_ode, params_A))
out_B <- as.data.frame(ode(init, times, malpractice_ode, params_B))
compute_R0 <- function(p) {
  S0 <- p["Lambda"] / p["mu"]
  (p["beta"] * p["sigma"] * S0) /
    ((p["sigma"] + p["tau"] + p["mu"]) *
     (p["alpha"] + p["delta"] + p["mu"]))
}
cat("R0 Scenario A:", round(compute_R0(params_A), 3), "\n")
cat("R0 Scenario B:", round(compute_R0(params_B), 3), "\n")
plot_compartment <- function(df, var, title_str, colour = "steelblue") {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_line(colour = colour, linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = title_str, x = "Time (years)", y = var) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

# Individual compartment plots (Scenario A)
p1 <- plot_compartment(out_A, "S", "Evolution of Susceptible individuals S(t)")
p2 <- plot_compartment(out_A, "M", "Evolution of Malpractice class M(t)", "firebrick")
p3 <- plot_compartment(out_A, "C", "Evolution of Cancelled results C(t)", "darkorange")
p4 <- plot_compartment(out_A, "R", "Evolution of Recovered class R(t)", "darkgreen")
p5 <- plot_compartment(out_A, "H", "Evolution of Honest class H(t)", "navy")
```


```{r}
sensitivity_indices <- function(p) {
  sig <- p["sigma"]; tau <- p["tau"]; mu <- p["mu"]
  alp <- p["alpha"]; del <- p["delta"]
  A <- sig + tau + mu;  B <- alp + del + mu
  c(
    beta   =  1,
    Lambda =  1,
    sigma  =  B / (A + B),
    tau    = -tau / A,
    alpha  = -alp / B,
    delta  = -del / B,
    mu     = -1 - mu/A - mu/B
  )
}

si <- sensitivity_indices(params_B)
si_df <- data.frame(
  param = names(si),
  index = as.numeric(si),
  direction = ifelse(as.numeric(si) > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
)

ggplot(si_df, aes(x = reorder(param, index), y = index, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "steelblue", "Negative" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(title = "Sensitivity indices of R0",
       x = "Parameter", y = "Normalised sensitivity index",
       fill = "Impact") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
```{r}
T_end <- 6;  n <- 600
dt    <- T_end / n
times_oc <- seq(0, T_end, length.out = n + 1)

P1 <- 1; P2 <- 1; Q1 <- 10; Q2 <- 10; Q3 <- 10
p  <- params_B

# Initialise controls
w1 <- w2 <- w3 <- rep(0, n + 1)

tol  <- 1e-6; max_iter <- 1000
converged <- FALSE

for (iter in seq_len(max_iter)) {
  w1_old <- w1; w2_old <- w2; w3_old <- w3

  # --- Forward sweep (state equations) ---
  X <- matrix(0, nrow = n + 1, ncol = 6)
  X[1, ] <- as.numeric(init)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    S_ <- X[i,1]; E_ <- X[i,2]; M_ <- X[i,3]
    C_ <- X[i,4]; R_ <- X[i,5]; H_ <- X[i,6]
    w1i <- w1[i]; w2i <- w2[i]; w3i <- w3[i]
    with(as.list(p), {
      X[i+1, 1] <<- S_ + dt*(Lambda + omega*H_ - (1-w1i)*beta*S_*M_ - mu*S_)
      X[i+1, 2] <<- E_ + dt*((1-w1i)*beta*S_*M_ - (tau+w2i+sigma+mu)*E_)
      X[i+1, 3] <<- M_ + dt*(sigma*E_ - (mu+alpha+w3i+delta)*M_)
      X[i+1, 4] <<- C_ + dt*((alpha+w3i)*M_ - (mu+gamma)*C_)
      X[i+1, 5] <<- R_ + dt*(gamma*C_ + delta*M_ - (eps+mu)*R_)
      X[i+1, 6] <<- H_ + dt*((tau+w2i)*E_ + eps*R_ - (omega+mu)*H_)
    })
  }

  # --- Backward sweep (adjoint equations) ---
  lam <- matrix(0, nrow = n + 1, ncol = 6)

  for (i in n:1) {
    S_ <- X[i,1]; E_ <- X[i,2]; M_ <- X[i,3]
    lS <- lam[i+1,1]; lE <- lam[i+1,2]; lH <- lam[i+1,6]
    lM <- lam[i+1,4]; lC <- lam[i+1,5]; lR <- lam[i+1,6]
    w1i <- w1[i]; w2i <- w2[i]; w3i <- w3[i]
    with(as.list(p), {
      lam[i,1] <<- lS + dt*(lS*(mu+(1-w1i)*beta*M_) - lE*(1-w1i)*beta*M_)
      lam[i,2] <<- lE + dt*(P1 + lE*(tau+w2i+sigma+mu) - lH*(tau+w2i) - lM*sigma)
      lam[i,3] <<- lam[i+1,3] + dt*(lam[i+1,3]*(omega+mu) - lS*omega)
      lam[i,4] <<- lM + dt*(P2 + lS*(1-w1i)*beta*S_ - lE*(1-w1i)*beta*S_
                    + lM*(mu+alpha+w3i+delta) - lC*(alpha+w3i) - lR*delta)
      lam[i,5] <<- lC + dt*(lC*(mu+gamma) - lR*gamma)
      lam[i,6] <<- lR + dt*(lR*(eps+mu) - lH*eps)
    })
  }

  # --- Update controls ---
  for (i in seq_len(n + 1)) {
    S_ <- X[i,1]; E_ <- X[i,2]; M_ <- X[i,3]
    lS <- lam[i,1]; lE <- lam[i,2]; lH <- lam[i,3]
    lM <- lam[i,4]; lC <- lam[i,5]
    w1[i] <- min(1, max(0, (lE - lS) * p["beta"] * S_ * M_ / Q1))
    w2[i] <- min(1, max(0, (lH - lE) * E_ / Q2))
    w3[i] <- min(1, max(0, (lC - lM) * M_ / Q3))
  }

  # --- Check convergence ---
  err <- max(abs(w1 - w1_old), abs(w2 - w2_old), abs(w3 - w3_old))
  if (err < tol) { converged <- TRUE; break }
}
cat("Converged:", converged, "after", iter, "iterations\n")

# Plot M(t): optimal vs no control
M_ctrl   <- X[, 3]
out_noctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(init, times_oc, malpractice_ode, params_B))
df_compare <- data.frame(
  time = times_oc,
  M_no_control = out_noctrl$M,
  M_optimal    = M_ctrl
)
df_long <- pivot_longer(df_compare, -time,
              names_to = "Strategy", values_to = "M")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = time, y = M, colour = Strategy, linetype = Strategy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("M_no_control" = "firebrick",
                                 "M_optimal"    = "steelblue")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("M_no_control" = "dashed",
                                   "M_optimal"    = "solid")) +
  labs(title = "Impact of optimal control on malpractice engagement M(t)",
       x = "Time (years)", y = "Students engaging in malpractice") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
